key_points: Intel posted a sharp earnings miss and weak revenue guidance, leading to a 23% drop last month.
The stock experienced its worst monthly performance since 1980, indicating severe investor pessimism.
Multiple bearish articles highlight risks and question future growth prospects for Intel.
Increased competition from AMD and other chipmakers, plus sector-wide sell‑off, adds pressure.
Potential downside remains unless Intel demonstrates a clear turnaround or new catalyst.
